title: Validator metadata
description: Draft validator snapshot metadata. This schema checks structure, not source provenance or proof acceptance.

validator_name.description: Actual selected validator name; use the full entry title where applicable.

source_repository.description: Canonical HTTPS URL of the IO upstream repository from which this snapshot was obtained.

source_commit.description: Exact full Git commit SHA in the named IO upstream repository.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw bytes of file_name at source_commit; not a CBOR digest.

cbor_hex.description: Full CBOR-encoded validator script, in hex, at the recorded parameterization state.

plutus_version.description: Plutus language version of the recorded compiled validator.

parameterization_state.description: No validator parameters exist, none have been applied, some have been applied, or all have been applied.

items.description: Complete CBOR hex for one serialized parameter value.

applied_parameters.description: Exact serialized values already applied to the recorded script, in application order.

compiler_version.description: Exact compiler version and build identifier, when known. Optional.
